metrics.name: Total Card Spend
metrics.description: Approved purchase value across the card book — the marketplace GMV of the portfolio and the base for interchange.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND response = 'APPROVED'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND response = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Interest + Fee Income
metrics.description: Interest charged on revolving balances plus annual and late fees. The primary revenue engine alongside interchange.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(interest_charged_inr) + SUM(fees_inr), 0) AS value FROM statements
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(cycle_end AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(interest_charged_inr) + SUM(fees_inr), 0) AS value FROM statements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Forex Markup Income
metrics.description: Foreign-exchange markup earned on international transactions. A high-margin revenue line tied to travel and cross-border spend.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(forex_markup_paid_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE is_intl_flag = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(forex_markup_paid_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE is_intl_flag = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Campaign Conversion Rate
metrics.description: Share of campaign contacts that converted. Realistic 1-3% for credit-card cross-sell/upgrade campaigns.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'CONVERTED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM campaign_history
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'CONVERTED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM campaign_history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Campaigns Sent
metrics.description: Total campaign contacts dispatched. The top of the cross-sell/upgrade funnel.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM campaign_history
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM campaign_history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Cost per Acquisition
metrics.description: Total contact cost divided by conversions. The efficiency of the cross-sell program.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(contact_cost_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'CONVERTED'), 0), 0) AS value FROM campaign_history
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(contact_cost_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'CONVERTED'), 0), 0) AS value FROM campaign_history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Revolve Rate
metrics.description: Share of statements carrying a revolving balance. The single biggest profitability lever — revolvers drive most interest revenue.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN revolve_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM statements
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(cycle_end AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN revolve_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM statements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Average Credit Utilization
metrics.description: Average credit-limit utilization across statements. 10-30% is healthy; persistently high is an early delinquency signal.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(utilization_pct), 1) AS value FROM statements
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(cycle_end AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(AVG(utilization_pct), 1) AS value FROM statements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Active Cards
metrics.description: Cards currently in active status. The live, spending portfolio.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM cards WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(issue_date AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM cards WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Card Attrition Rate
metrics.description: Share of cards that are closed. The portfolio churn signal to defend against with reactivation.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM cards
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(issue_date AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM cards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Spend per Active Card
metrics.description: Approved purchase value per active card. The engagement-and-monetization density of the live book.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.amount_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.card_id), 0), 0) AS value FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.card_id WHERE t.txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND t.response = 'APPROVED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(t.txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(t.amount_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.card_id), 0), 0) AS value FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.card_id WHERE t.txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND t.response = 'APPROVED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Rewards Redemption Rate
metrics.description: Average share of earned reward points redeemed. Low redemption signals disengagement and points-liability risk.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(redemption_rate_pct), 1) AS value FROM rewards_summary
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(c.issue_date AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(AVG(r.redemption_rate_pct), 1) AS value FROM rewards_summary r JOIN cards c ON r.card_id = c.card_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: UPI-on-Credit Spend Share
metrics.description: Share of approved purchase value transacted on UPI. The growth surface for credit-on-UPI engagement.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'UPI' THEN amount_inr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_inr), 0), 1) AS value FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND response = 'APPROVED'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'UPI' THEN amount_inr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_inr), 0), 1) AS value FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'PURCHASE' AND response = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: EMI Conversion Volume
metrics.description: Purchase value converted to EMI. High-intent financing that drives interest revenue and cross-sell.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE emi_converted_flag = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE emi_converted_flag = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Cross-sell Penetration
metrics.description: Share of cardholders who also hold another bank product. The inverse of card-only whitespace.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ph.customer_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers), 0), 1) AS value FROM product_holdings ph
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(opened_date AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM product_holdings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
